ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising edge that sequences updates in the two clocked processes; it times writes to lock_q and updates of bus_rsp_o fields on each rising edge.
ports.evidence: Used as rising_edge(clk_i) in spinlock and bus_response processes that assign lock_q and bus_rsp_o.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Drives the reset branch of both clocked processes; when '0' it forces lock_q to zeros and bus_rsp_o to rsp_terminate_c, overriding normal updates.
ports.evidence: Checked as if (rstn_i = '0') in the reset branches of spinlock and bus_response processes.

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Bundles the bus request fields; the entity references individual fields (addr, stb, rw) elsewhere, but the aggregate bus_req_i is not used directly.
ports.evidence: Declared as bus_req_t in port clause; code accesses individual fields (e.g. bus_req_i.addr, bus_req_i.stb) rather than bus_req_i itself.

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: address input that selects lock index and mode
ports.functionality: Provides address bits used to select which lock bit sel(i) is asserted (bits 6 downto 2) and to distinguish modes via bit 7; it gates lock updates and selects the response data form.
ports.evidence: Used as addr(6 downto 2) in sel assignment and as addr(7) in spinlock and bus_response if conditions.

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.function: unused data field of bus request
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request record but not referenced anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port clause; no references in processes or concurrent statements.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not used in this entity's source.
ports.evidence: Only present in the port declaration; not referenced elsewhere.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active bus transfer; it gates lock updates, gates read-response generation, and is forwarded to bus_rsp_o.ack each cycle to acknowledge the transfer.
ports.evidence: Used in spinlock assignment condition and in bus_response if (bus_req_i.stb = '1'); also assigned to bus_rsp_o.ack in bus_response.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Supplies the operation type: it is negated and captured into lock_q on qualified accesses, and it participates in gating read responses (checked for '0' to produce data).
ports.evidence: Used as RHS in lock_q(i) <= not bus_req_i.rw and in bus_response condition (bus_req_i.rw = '0').

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request record but not referenced in this entity.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port clause.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record and not used by this entity.
ports.evidence: Only present in the port declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Part of the bus request record but not referenced in the source code.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this entity's source.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port clause.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Present in the bus request record but never referenced in this entity.
ports.evidence: Only declared in the port list.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared in the record but not referenced within this source; lock behaviour is implemented via addr/stb/rw/sel rather than this field.
ports.evidence: Only appears in the port declaration; not read anywhere in the code.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this entity's RTL.
ports.evidence: Only present in the port clause.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Drives the response record to the bus master: at reset it is set to rsp_terminate_c and on each rising clock its fields (ack, err, data) are updated from internal signals and bus_req_i fields.
ports.evidence: Assigned as bus_rsp_o <= rsp_terminate_c on reset and its fields are assigned from lock_q/sel and bus_req_i fields in bus_response process.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Reports the incoming bus transfer strobe each clock: on rising edge it captures bus_req_i.stb and is exported to the bus master as the transfer acknowledgement.
ports.evidence: Assigned in bus_response process: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb on rising_edge(clk_i).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Driven low each clock in the response process; it is produced as a constant '0' and exported to the bus master.
ports.evidence: Assigned bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in the rising_edge branch of the bus_response process.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries read data: on reads (bus_req_i.rw='0' and stb) it is assigned either lock_q masked by sel (when addr(7)='0') or the full lock_q; otherwise it defaults to zero each cycle.
ports.evidence: In bus_response: bus_rsp_o.data <= (others => '0') then on read and addr(7)='0' data <= lock_q and sel else data <= lock_q.

signals.name: lock_q
signals.functionality: Holds the 32 lock bits across cycles; individual bits are reset to '0' and on qualified accesses each bit captures the negated bus_req_i.rw value, and the vector is read out to bus_rsp_o.data.
signals.evidence: Assigned in spinlock process on rising_edge(clk_i) and reset branch; read in bus_response assignments to bus_rsp_o.data.

signals.name: sel
signals.function: one-hot select vector for lock index
signals.functionality: Combinationally derives which lock bit is selected from bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2); sel(i) gates per-bit updates and masks reads when constructing bus_rsp_o.data.
signals.evidence: Assigned by concurrent when-expression comparing bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2) to to_unsigned(i,5); used in spinlock condition and in bus_rsp_o.data <= lock_q and sel.
